brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Schedule a technician to repair my broken dishwasher at my home as soon as possible.
facts: My Whirlpool dishwasher is leaking from the bottom during the wash cycle.
I am available on Thursday morning.
preferences: Prefer a morning time slot over an afternoon one.
Prefer to pay with a credit card upon completion rather than in advance.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, up to the not-to-exceed figure they quote

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated IVR
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Appliance Repair. For service scheduling, press 1. For billing, press 2.

script.label: Representative 1 (Intake)
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Appliance Repair, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

script.label: Representative 1 (Intake)
script.text: I can certainly help you get someone out to look at your leaking dishwasher.

script.label: Representative 1 (Intake)
script.text: Our diagnostic fee and initial service visit is exactly 160 dollars.

script.label: Representative 1 (Intake)
script.text: Let me transfer you over to our field dispatcher, Mark, who handles booking the specific technician routes. One moment.

script.label: Representative 2 (Dispatcher)
script.text: Hi there, this is Mark in dispatch. Sarah told me you need dishwasher service.

script.label: Representative 2 (Dispatcher)
script.text: Could you please provide your service address?

script.label: Representative 2 (Dispatcher)
script.text: Thank you. I have an opening next Thursday, the eighth, between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM. Does that work for you?

script.label: Representative 2 (Dispatcher)
script.text: I will go ahead and lock that arrival window in for you.

script.label: Representative 2 (Dispatcher)
script.text: Okay, you are all set for Thursday the eighth between 9 and 12, and our tech will call thirty minutes before arriving.

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
